_comment: Reference payload for Automatic1111 WebUI v1.6.0 POST /sdapi/v1/txt2img. Written by src/generation/generate_a1111.py; kept here so the request shape that produced the SD-native and NovelAI conditions is part of the repository. 'prompt' carries the rendered syntax: [[fox]] for SD-native level W1 and {{fox}} for NovelAI level W3.

payload.prompt: a red [[fox]] standing in fresh snow
payload.negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, distorted, ugly, bad anatomy

payload.prompt: a red {{fox}} standing in fresh snow
payload.negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, distorted, ugly, bad anatomy

novelai_extension.name: stable-diffusion-webui-novelai-prompt-weights
novelai_extension.semantics: each { } pair multiplies the enclosed token embedding by 1.05, each [ ] pair by 0.95
